talking_points: Agent platform readiness: the new SQL Engine and Postgres-compatible endpoint put Attio squarely in agentic revenue — ask how customers are governing thousands of agents (permissions, observability, credit costs) and where they need tooling partners to plug in.

Mid-market/enterprise gaps: recent G2/Capterra reviews flag missing field permissions, validation rules, multi-currency and reporting — probe whether enterprise readiness is on the roadmap and how their team closes the gap vs Salesforce/HubSpot.

Pricing & packaging momentum: after the July 2026 repricing (Plus $35 / Pro $79 annual), ask how the sales team is handling price-pushback and spreadsheet-to-CRM migrations, and whether partners can support onboarding and migration demand.
